note: Re-quantization of the pinned bf16 MTP head (EigenLabs/Qwen3.8-27B-MTP-bf16 @ 26a328e0), MLX 0.32.0 mx.quantize affine: fc.weight at 6-bit group-64, the seven other 2D projections at 4-bit group-64 (the current frontier geometry), 1D norms bf16. Per-tensor session measurements attribute the entire draft-acceptance cost of uniform 4-bit to fc.weight; 6-bit fc buys back about half the lost tokens-per-round on hard text for +13.1 MB per draft step. The head only proposes - every emitted token is the pinned target's own greedy continuation, and the committed stream is measured identical to the stock head's stream on both test windows. Loader support: the quantization walk infers per-tensor (group,bits) from scales/packed shapes for mtp.* paths (Load.swift), a no-op for backbone tensors and for heads matching backbone geometry.
